name: Redfish (Red Drum)
description: Louisiana's most popular inshore gamefish, known for their bronze color and distinctive black spot near the tail.

topPicks.name: Live Shrimp
topPicks.tip: Fish under a popping cork in 2-4ft of water

topPicks.name: Gold Spoon
topPicks.tip: Work over grass flats on incoming tide

rigs.name: Popping Cork Rig
rigs.description: 18-24" leader below cork, great for sight and sound

rigs.name: Carolina Rig
rigs.description: Egg sinker above swivel, 2ft leader, for deeper water

rigs.name: Texas Rig
rigs.description: Weedless soft plastic, great around structure

rigs.name: Free-line
rigs.description: No weight, let live bait swim naturally

tidePhase.description: Redfish feed actively on incoming and outgoing tides, especially around structure and oyster beds.

windSpeed.description: Light to moderate winds. Strong winds can muddy water but may push baitfish into feeding zones.

waterTemp.description: Most active in warm water. Will tolerate cooler temps but slow down below 60°F.

salinity.description: Highly adaptable, found in brackish to saltwater. Can tolerate fresh water.

moonPhase.description: Very active during new and full moon phases due to stronger tides.

timeOfDay.description: Peak feeding at dawn and dusk. Will feed throughout the day in cooler months.

seasonalPatterns.description: Fall is prime time as fish feed heavily. Spring and summer are excellent. Winter fishing slows but still productive on warm days.

name: Speckled Trout
description: Prized gamefish with distinctive black spots. Found in grass flats and around structure.

rigs.name: Popping Cork Rig
rigs.description: Most popular, creates commotion to attract fish

rigs.name: Free-line
rigs.description: No weight for shallow water, natural presentation

rigs.name: Drop Shot
rigs.description: For suspended fish in deeper water

rigs.name: Jig Head + Soft Plastic
rigs.description: 1/8-1/4oz, match the depth

tidePhase.description: Active on moving water, especially outgoing tides that wash bait out of marshes.

windSpeed.description: Prefer calmer conditions. Light chop can help, but strong winds make them harder to locate.

waterTemp.description: Very temperature sensitive. Best bite in comfortable water temps. Move to deeper water when too hot or cold.

salinity.description: Prefer brackish to saltwater. Less tolerant of low salinity than redfish.

moonPhase.description: Good during moon phases with stronger tides, but less dependent than redfish.

timeOfDay.description: Prime time is early morning. Dusk is second best. Night fishing can be excellent in summer.

seasonalPatterns.description: Spring is peak season. Fall run is excellent. Summer requires early/late fishing. Winter fish move deep.

name: Flounder
description: Flatfish that ambush prey from the bottom. Excellent table fare.

topPicks.name: Live Mud Minnow
topPicks.tip: Fish on bottom with Carolina rig

rigs.name: Carolina Rig
rigs.description: 1/2oz egg sinker, 18" leader - keeps bait on bottom

rigs.name: Bucktail Jig
rigs.description: 1/4-3/8oz, drag slowly on bottom

rigs.name: Drop Shot
rigs.description: For gigging spots and deeper channels

rigs.name: Knocker Rig
rigs.description: Weight slides to hook, great for feeling bites

tidePhase.description: Best on outgoing tides when they position at passes and channels to ambush bait.

windSpeed.description: Prefer calm conditions. Bottom feeders less affected by wind than other species.

waterTemp.description: Active in moderate temps. Migrate offshore in winter, return in spring.

salinity.description: Prefer saltier water. Often found near passes and Gulf access.

moonPhase.description: Moon phase less critical than tides and current for flounder.

timeOfDay.description: Good all day. Peak activity at dawn and dusk when baitfish are most active.

seasonalPatterns.description: Fall is best as they stage for offshore migration. Summer is excellent. Sparse in winter.

name: Black Drum
description: Large bottom feeder known for powerful fights. Often found around structure.

rigs.name: Fish Finder Rig
rigs.description: Sliding sinker for feeding fish to run with bait

rigs.name: Carolina Rig
rigs.description: Standard bottom rig, 1-2oz weight

rigs.name: Double Drop
rigs.description: Two hooks for big drum around structure

rigs.name: Knocker Rig
rigs.description: Weight at hook for better bite detection

tidePhase.description: Feed actively during moving water around oyster beds and structure.

windSpeed.description: Less wind-sensitive as bottom feeders. Can handle rougher conditions.

waterTemp.description: Tolerate a wide temp range. Active in cooler water than many species.

salinity.description: Very adaptable to different salinity levels.

moonPhase.description: Consistent feeders less affected by moon phase than other species.

timeOfDay.description: Can be caught any time. Dawn and dusk slightly better.

seasonalPatterns.description: Spring spawning run is prime time. Good year-round in Louisiana.

name: Sheepshead
description: Structure-oriented fish with human-like teeth. Excellent table fare.

topPicks.name: Fiddler Crab
topPicks.tip: Hook through shell, fish tight to pilings

rigs.name: Tight-line Rig
rigs.description: Small hook (#1-2), light sinker, fish vertical

rigs.name: Split Shot Rig
rigs.description: Minimal weight for natural fall

rigs.name: Dropper Rig
rigs.description: Single hook above small weight

rigs.name: Free-line
rigs.description: No weight around structure, let crab sink naturally

tidePhase.description: Feed on moving tides around pilings, rocks, and oyster beds.

windSpeed.description: Fish tight to structure regardless of wind, but calmer is better for presenting baits.

waterTemp.description: One of the best cold-weather species. Most active in cooler water.

salinity.description: Prefer saltier water near structure and bridges.

moonPhase.description: Structure-oriented feeding less dependent on moon phase.

timeOfDay.description: Daytime feeders. Midday can be excellent around structure.

seasonalPatterns.description: Winter and early spring are prime time. Summer fish move offshore to deeper water.

name: Snook
description: Warm-water gamefish prized for their aggressive strikes and fighting ability.

topPicks.name: Live Pilchard
topPicks.tip: Free-line near structure on tide change

rigs.name: Free-line
rigs.description: No weight, let bait swim naturally to structure

rigs.name: Split Shot
rigs.description: Minimal weight for deeper presentations

rigs.name: Fluorocarbon Leader
rigs.description: 30-40lb, snook have rough gill plates

rigs.name: Jig Head + Paddle Tail
rigs.description: 1/4oz, swim and twitch retrieve

tidePhase.description: Highly tide-dependent. Position at passes and current breaks to ambush bait.

windSpeed.description: Some wind helps oxygenate water and position baitfish.

waterTemp.description: Warm water species. Very active in summer heat. Sensitive to cold.

salinity.description: Move between fresh and saltwater following bait and temperature.

moonPhase.description: Strong moon phases trigger aggressive feeding, especially during spawning.

timeOfDay.description: Dawn and dusk are magic hours. Night fishing can be phenomenal in summer.

seasonalPatterns.description: Summer is prime time. Very temperature sensitive - rare in South Louisiana but increasing.

name: Tarpon
description: The 'Silver King' - powerful gamefish known for spectacular aerial displays.

topPicks.name: Live Mullet
topPicks.tip: 6-8 inch mullet, free-lined or under float

topPicks.name: Live Crab
topPicks.tip: Pass crab, hooked through corner of shell

rigs.name: Circle Hook Rig
rigs.description: 7/0-9/0 circle hook, 60-80lb fluorocarbon leader

rigs.name: Float Rig
rigs.description: Balloon or float to keep bait at target depth

rigs.name: Free-line
rigs.description: Let big mullet swim naturally to feeding fish

rigs.name: Heavy Spinning
rigs.description: For casting lures to rolling/feeding fish

tidePhase.description: Very active on moving water, especially incoming tides bringing bait.

windSpeed.description: Light winds preferable for sight fishing. Can handle moderate winds.

waterTemp.description: Warm water species. Most active in summer heat.

salinity.description: Prefer saltier water but can tolerate brackish conditions.

moonPhase.description: Strong tides during moon phases trigger feeding. Spawning related to moon.

timeOfDay.description: Dawn and dusk are prime. Can be caught all day when actively feeding or migrating.

seasonalPatterns.description: Summer migration is peak season. Spring and fall runs excellent. Winter fish move south.
